By applying the said parameters and considering facts and circumstances and the material collected during the investigation, admittedly, no prima facie case is made out to show connection between the applicants and the other co-accused and there is also no material to show that the applicants were intending to purchase the food grains reserved for the students studying in the Municipal Schools.
In the absence of any primary evidence against the applicants, they have made out a case for quashing of the FIR.
In view of that, both the applications deserve to be allowed.

 ORDER (1) The criminal applications are allowed.
